name: Investigator OPSEC & Research Environment Management
description: Covers protecting the investigator, the client, and the investigation during open-source research: attribution-resistant research environments (isolated virtual machines, managed egress, browser fingerprint control), research account governance under documented legal and policy approval, and logging of research activity so that every collection step is auditable. Includes assessing the exposure an investigation creates and handling compromise of a research identity. Target-specific collection tradecraft belongs to INTEL-OSINT-SOCIAL and INTEL-OSINT-PERSON.

0.label: None
0.description: No exposure to investigator operational security or managed research environments

1.label: Awareness
1.description: Understands how open-source research can expose the investigator, the client, and the investigation
evidence: Can describe how browsing activity, IP addresses, and fingerprints can attribute research to the lab or client
Understands that research accounts require documented legal and policy approval before use
Aware of the lab's requirements for logging research activity

2.label: Guided Practice
2.description: Conducts research from approved environments under supervision
evidence: Performs assigned research only from lab-provisioned, isolated research environments
Uses approved research accounts within their documented scope and records each use
Maintains a complete research activity log (time, environment, account, sources accessed) that is reviewed by a senior investigator
Reports suspected exposure or account compromise to the supervising investigator

3.label: Independent Practice
3.description: Independently plans and maintains OPSEC for investigations
evidence: Produces an OPSEC plan per investigation covering exposure risks, environment, egress, and approved accounts across 3+ engagements
Builds, resets, and verifies research environments against the lab's baseline before and after use
Operates research accounts within approved legal and policy boundaries, with approvals on file
Research logs are complete enough for an independent reviewer to reconstruct collection; work passes QA review

4.label: Advanced / Mentor
4.description: Manages research infrastructure and account governance; mentors investigators
evidence: Maintains the lab's research environment images, egress options, and fingerprint controls
Administers the research account register: approval, scope, lifecycle, and retirement
Leads response to a burned research identity or environment exposure, including impact assessment and client notification where required
Mentors investigators on OPSEC planning and audit-ready logging

5.label: Expert / Authority
5.description: Defines the lab's investigator OPSEC policy and research environment standards; trains teams
evidence: Designed or maintains the lab's investigator OPSEC policy, research account governance procedure, and logging standard
Agreed the legal and policy approval framework for research accounts with legal counsel and management
Assesses emerging attribution techniques and updates environment standards accordingly
Trains teams on investigator OPSEC and research environment management

assessment_methods.description: Provision a research environment from the lab baseline, conduct a defined open-source research task using an approved research account, then demonstrate fingerprint and egress checks and hand over a complete research log
Review an investigation's OPSEC plan, account approvals, and research activity logs for completeness, adherence to approved scope, and ability to reconstruct the collection
